_format.source: Restriction text in courses.json (UMD catalog 2026-2027). Every course with restriction text needs an entry.
_format.min_credits: Credits a student must have earned before taking the course.
_format.programs: The student must be in one of these programs (names as written in the catalog), or null for no program limit.
_format.not_after: The course can't be taken after completing any of these courses (only courses in courses.json).
_format.other: Conditions not modeled above (permission, campus, role), shown to students as-is.
_format.avoid_in_plan: true when 'other' means the course isn't generally open (permission-only, another campus, a specific role), so the planner won't pick it as an elective. Required courses are still planned, with the condition shown.
